# Document verification — SCI-FRUIT v0.1 / Stage B r0.1

Date: 2026-09-07. Scope: **new documents only**. No numerical method, experiment, replay, scientific validation, implementation assessment, production or Unity activity was performed. The core is an owner-review draft, not frozen.

| Check | Result and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Exact author input | Supplied 18,734-byte manifest digest matches its sidecar; all eleven permitted payload sizes/SHA-256 match. Permission and approval controls agree with [source identities](SOURCE_IDENTITIES.md). Manager-only payloads/archives/originals were not opened. |
| Approved-input preservation | All allowed source/control hashes rechecked unchanged at closure. No writes outside this new Stage B output path; bounded Git housekeeping checks the changed path set. |
| Independent review | [Two substantive rounds](review/REVIEW_REPORT.md), within maximum three. One low-severity inherited evidence-gate omission repaired and closed. No open scientific-consistency finding or new owner premise. All twelve source/ledger files bound by round 2 match the final files. |
| Canonical authority | Six required common LaTeX modules supply both views. Each common content unit renders once per view. Twenty-four stable requirements, complete twenty-one-row method record, twenty stable predictions, and decision/owner records retained. |
| Compilation | Both views compile with local Tectonic and cached resources. Final logs contain zero warnings, overfull/underfull boxes, undefined references, missing characters or LaTeX errors. |
| Main narrative | Scientist pages 1–10 contain the ten main scientific sections. Appendices begin on page 11; total 28 pages. Engineering view has the same 28 content pages with conformance records first. |
| PDF parity | All twenty-eight corresponding content units have identical extracted content after normalizing only headers/footers, whitespace, Unicode ligatures, leading section numbers and Section/Appendix reference numbers. Equations, claims, predictions and inventories agree. This is content parity, not identical PDF bytes; view order and navigation differ. |
| Local references | TeX includes exist; PDF named destinations resolve inside their respective 28 pages; all output Markdown links target new outputs or the exact permitted payloads/controls. Archive/manifests are checked after packaging. |
| Poppler and visual inspection | Both final PDFs rendered with Poppler at 100 dpi. Root inspected every page in 28 paired sheets: scientist pages 1–28 and engineering pages 1–28. Zero open clipping, overlap, missing-glyph, table, margin, footer or page-transition defects. [Page inspection](qa/PAGE_INSPECTION.json) binds the inspected PDF hashes. |
| Exact output identities and delivery parity | [Artifact manifest](ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.md) binds regular delivery files, byte counts and SHA-256; [sidecar](ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.sha256) binds the manifest. The [review archive](SCI-FRUIT-v0.1-stage-b-r0.1-owner-review.tar.gz) contains exactly those files plus manifest/sidecar, with identical bytes and no extra paths/symlinks. Its [digest](SCI-FRUIT-v0.1-stage-b-r0.1-owner-review.tar.gz.sha256) is external. |

The [machine-readable document checks](qa/DOCUMENT_CHECKS.json) retain counts and PDF identities. [Build/render tooling](qa/build_documents.py), [artifact checks](qa/verify_documents.py) and [packaging checks](qa/package_documents.py) are local document tools. They do not execute repository tests or assess numerical conformance. Transient cached fonts, logs, intermediate TeX files and PNGs are excluded from the delivery archive and Git commit.

Initial tooling defects were resolved locally: the default Tectonic initialization/cache path failed, so compilation used a local copy of already cached TeX resources and an explicit task cache; a missing legacy math font was avoided by using cached Latin Modern fonts. Long identifiers and table typography were repaired. These are document-only fixes; no web source or scientific input was added. Rendering subprocesses used `MPLBACKEND=Agg` and task-specific writable `MPLCONFIGDIR`, `XDG_CACHE_HOME` and `TECTONIC_CACHE_DIR`.

The final packet/approval controls, unlisted repository/status/navigation files, original archives and reduction products remain unchanged. Coherent new documents are committed with hooks disabled to avoid unlisted test/audit execution. No push is performed. Grant Wilson retains the separate Stage B scientific review/conditional-freeze decision; all numerical methods/routes remain `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`.
